allowed_claims: The CPJUMP1 figure is a processed-profile phenotypic restoration benchmark.
The Disease Search component includes an offline prescripted validation and a live ClinicalTrials probe.
The GAP lane rules are deterministic and refuse therapeutic recommendation output.
OpenAI fan-out outputs are recorded as custody objects.
The API key is used locally and is not committed.
The model trace inventories local model sizes and records which OpenAI model tiers actually ran helper agents.
The known-pair benchmark did not beat the shuffle null in the tiny cached run, so it is shown as a conservative negative result.

citations.label: Custody-Verified Classification of AI Model Outputs

core_terms.FCG: Fractal Custody Graph: linked FCO-style records whose hashes and inputs preserve custody.
core_terms.FCO: Fractal Custody Object: one content-addressed evidence, model, agent, or integration record.
core_terms.GAP_lane: Deterministic rare disease repurposing gap finder: disease -> targets -> programs -> prior trials -> rule grade.
core_terms.MMR: Maximal Marginal Relevance, cited for diversity-aware reranking design; not required for the primary restoration-distance result.
core_terms.Merkle_root: A single hash committing to the ordered set of custody records under the declared RFC 6962 convention.
